families.differentiation: Session-structure entries exist in the judged set only as crypto intraday patterns (session_effects) and a range-breakout family (session_breakout, crypto); neither conditions on the Asia range nor on the London liquidity event, and FX session structure has no crypto analogue.
families.mechanism: Asia-range -> London expansion: the 00:00-07:00 UTC range forms in thin trade; a 07:00-bar close outside it, held through the London session (exit at 17:00 UTC), rides the day's primary FX liquidity event.
families.name: london_drive

signal_rules.exit: bracket_time sl 2.0 / tp 4.0 ATR, max_bars 9 (08:00 -> 17:00 UTC)
signal_rules.filter_narrow: drive_narrow additionally requires Asia range width < 1.0 x ATR(14) (compression before expansion)
signal_rules.signal_bar: the 07:00 UTC bar: close above the Asia high (00:00-06:59 bars, >= 4 required) -> LONG; below the Asia low -> SHORT; fill at the 08:00 open

families.differentiation: dow_effect conditions on weekday identity (crypto daily bars); this family conditions on the weekend GAP SIZE, an artefact that only exists because FX closes for the weekend. No judged family uses gap conditioning.
families.mechanism: Friday->Monday weekend-gap fade: FX closes over the weekend; Monday's open gaps against Friday's close as positions reprice. Gaps beyond theta x ATR% are faded over up to 3 days.
families.name: monday_gap_fade

signal_rules.declared_deviation: Entries are decided at Monday's open from the gap itself and filled at that open (open-auction semantics) — the only family in the programme using open-known information; implemented as signal bar = Friday, fill = Monday open.
signal_rules.signal: gap = Monday open / Friday close - 1; SHORT if gap > theta x ATR%(14), LONG if gap < -theta x ATR%

families.differentiation: Every judged trend family enters on breakouts (donchian/compression), crosses (macd/ts_momentum) or thrusts (shock); none enters on a retracement touch-and-reclaim inside an established trend. The entry type is the claim.
families.mechanism: FX trend persistence traded on retracement: inside an established trend (close beyond EMA_T, EMA_T rising/falling over 10 bars), buy the first bar that touches EMA20 and closes back through it in the trend direction; exit by 3.0 ATR trailing stop (2.0 ATR initial).
families.name: trend_pullback

signal_rules.entry: uptrend: low <= EMA20 x 1.001, close > EMA20, close > open -> LONG; mirror for shorts
signal_rules.exit: trail sl 2.0 ATR initial, trail 3.0 ATR

judgement.bar: rd2.stats2.check_bar2 with rd2.stats2.holdout2, identical to RD-002/RD-003: expectancy_net > 0 AND profit_factor_net >= 1.2 AND >= 200 pooled OOS trades AND positive folds >= ceil(0.8 x profile folds) with trades in >= (profile folds - 1) folds AND holdout2 passes (breadth >= 50% of symbols with >= 20 OOS trades positive; max single-symbol profit share <= 0.5; untouched subset = every 3rd symbol alphabetically, >= 30 trades with expectancy > 0; >= 3 active symbols).
judgement.cost_sensitivity: Exact 2x-cost PF from saved trades (RD-003 synth3 construction: net2x = 2*net - gross, over the cell's pooled OOS windows). A cell that passes the bar and the significance gate is a FINAL passer only if its 2x-cost PF >= 1.2. Sensitivity is also reported for near-bar rows (expectancy > 0, PF >= 1.15, >= 200 trades).

global_counter.prior_floor_basis: running global counter floor per coordinator accounting (>= 1,926 through RD-005)

judgement.procedures: wf-select procedures (rd.common.wf_select_judge, unchanged) are reported with pooled OOS metrics and the same Bonferroni p for disclosure; per programme construction they are selection-honesty controls, not promotion candidates — only fixed-config cells can pass.
judgement.significance_gate: Bonferroni one-sided p (rd2.stats2.trade_stats over the cell's OOS trades, entry >= first profile fold start) < 0.05 / N_global. Deflated Sharpe is disclosed where computable, never gating (RD-003 construction).
